10900.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

east.description: To the east lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10900.description:
The current is gentle here, clear enough to see the bottom. Mud and
pebbles shift beneath the slow water. A way leads east.

10901.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

north.description: To the north lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10901.description:
Dust lies thick in the corners, undisturbed for some time. The air is
still and smells faintly of old smoke. Ways lead north and west.

10902.name: The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World

south.description: To the south lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

west.description: To the west lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

10902.description:
Stone walls close in, cool to the touch. Shadows gather where the light
does not reach. Ways lead south and west.
